If you're reading this, then you may be wondering what this sub will be for, well to put in short, this sub is for the presentation of ideas and projects for constructive criticism and feedback. This will be the place to present shower-thoughts, or ideas, or concepts, or art projects you may have. Do you like creative writing and have a few pages of a short story you want honest feedback on? Link it here. Our duty is to provide positive constructive criticism and reinforcement. In other words, critiquing. Except we don't want to provide the same type of critique that you will find anywhere else on Metacritic or some other forum, here we want to defy the status quo of critiquing and use what we know to better your idea or project, not make it worse or give a solidification.

I don't know where this sub will go from here, but if you are interested in posting, please feel free to do so! We are not going to bite. I will definitely need moderators, if you're interested then please send me a PM.

One last thing, although it's a part of the site, I highly condemn the use of downvoting here, especially for the content of the OP itself. If you want a discussion, then discuss, if you want a circlejerk, there's already a place for that, don't do it here. In the event that there's a comment or submission that is mockery, harsh, intentionally provoking, or violating voat's User Agreement, then that's what downvoting will be for. Downvoting comments because you disagree with them is not and never will be permitted here, if you disagree with someone's critique or want to discuss, then discuss, if not then refute and move on.

The basic idea of the ending was that while he was stuck on a really hard list item he was going to start to get frustrated that he was never going to finish it. He asks them where they got the idea of making a list and they tell him that someone came to them with a list and that person got the idea from someone else. Earl eventually realizes that his list started a chain reaction of people with list and that he’s finally put more good into the world than bad.
